reading.body:
Flexential Atlanta - Douglasville 2 publishes 36 MW of IT capacity across 358,000 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 36 MW of IT load is roughly 900 racks. At a more modest 10 kW per rack, a colocation average, the same power supports roughly 3,600 racks. The operator has not published which density standard applies here, so the rack count is an assumption that depends entirely on the workload mix a tenant brings.

The certification stack covers financial audit controls (SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, SSAE 18), payment card data (PCI DSS), federal controlled unclassified information (ITAR, NIST 800-53), and healthcare data (HITRUST). Each certification qualifies the campus to host a corresponding class of regulated workload. No certification inherently limits or enables AI compute, but ITAR clearance means tenants handling defense-related technical data can run here legally, which narrows the field of eligible operators.

Among the 33 Georgia facilities this site has mapped, only 2 publish a megawatt figure, and this campus ranks first among those two with 36 of the 42 published MW in the state, an 86 percent share. That share reflects the scarcity of published data more than the true distribution of Georgia capacity, since the remaining 31 mapped facilities publish no figure at all. Within the bounds of what is verifiable from operator spec pages, this campus is the largest single declared AI-eligible footprint this site has on record for Georgia.
